label: PF Backlog 593
title: EDP-12: Generated-product residency manifest (data_classes/home_region/allowed_regions/backup/kms/egress/retention) + build/deploy gate
body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.

brief.problem: No record or enforcement of where generated product data resides
brief.why: Enterprise compliance requires data-class and region guarantees

objective: Generate a per-product residency manifest (data_classes, home_region, allowed_regions, backup, kms, egress, retention) and enforce it via a build/deploy gate in Go (language rule L1).
acceptance_criteria: Packaging build emits residency manifest with all six field groups populated
Deploy gate fails (or warns per config) when manifest violates allowed_regions/retention policy
scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py passes for all Go code
approach: Extend existing manifest builders, add Go validation step to packaging build.
verification: Build emits manifest; gate blocks bad fixture; language rule review passes
risks: Go gate must satisfy language rule L1 review
Region/KMS field values depend on provider adapters (BI-PF-1306)
rollback: Disable gate via config flag; manifests remain informational.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/qa_manifest.py and run_manifest.py with a residency manifest schema (data_classes, home_region, allowed_regions, backup, kms, egress, retention); add a Go build/deploy gate that validates the manifest, exposed via /api/v1/packaging/manifest and build pipeline.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-1308 (lifecycle/retention policy) DONE for retention/backup fields
conflict_findings: BI-PF-1308 also touches retention/reconciliation concepts; align field definitions
duplication_findings: core/qa_manifest.py and run_manifest.py already produce manifests; reuse their patterns rather than a new manifest component
file-manifest.json covers file inventory, not residency — extend, not duplicate
analysis.rationale: Manifest extends existing manifest builders; only the Go gate check is modestly new.
assumptions: Manifest rides with existing packaging build artifact
Region topology known from EDP ADR (BI-PF-1293)
risks: Go gate must satisfy language rule L1 review
Region/KMS field values depend on provider adapters (BI-PF-1306)
missing_info: Enforcement action on gate failure: block vs warn

context_review.reason: Existing manifest modules and packaging APIs provide clear extension points; depends on EDP predecessor items.
